entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
Kiwi innovators are pushing the boundaries of sustainable transport, redefining navigation on land and water. 🚤 @vessev.marine  is transforming marine travel with electric hydrofoiling vessels—smooth, silent, and emissions-free, reducing energy use by up to 90% and @HMItechnologies (Ohmio) is revolutionising urban mobility with autonomous, zero-emission vehicles.

Together, these New Zealand companies are driving a greener tomorrow.🌍
